name: Camping 101: First Aid
summary: You are ready to make a First Aid Kit, and now you need a place to try it.

sections.title: A Place to Camp
sections.body: You can make the kit, but most people would rather not camp in the middle of town. So take it out into the wilderness. Before you set up camp, you need a campfire. Most cooks can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: Where can I try the First Aid Kit?
faq.answer: Try the First Aid Kit in the wilderness, where people are less likely to object to a camp.

faq.q: What do I need before setting up camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before you can set up camp.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a campfire?
faq.answer: Most cooks can teach you how to make a campfire.
